title: Special Relativity
modules: Galilean Transformation And Invariance Of Physical Equations
mcq: Fill in the blank: ______ is a pair of binary stars in which of them acts as a rapidly pulsating source of X-rays as it revolves about the other star.
A binary pulsar is a pair of binary stars in which of them acts as a rapidly pulsating source of X-rays as it revolves about the other star.
Fill in the blank: ______ is the coordinates of a point taken from the origin of a four-dimensional real space.
A world point is the coordinates of a point taken from the origin of a four-dimensional real space.
Fill in the blank: ______ is a study of the relationships between observations made in different frames of reference which are in relative motion to each other.
The theory of relativity is a study of the relationships between observations made in different frames of reference which are in relative motion to each other.
fib: ______ is a pair of stars which are rotating about their common centre of mass.
A binary star is a pair of stars which are rotating about their common centre of mass.
______ is one of the main pillars of Modern Physics as against what is known as Classical Physics.
Relativity is one of the main pillars of Modern Physics as against what is known as Classical Physics.
______ are the same for all inertial frames of reference.
Physical laws are the same for all inertial frames of reference.
